messages:
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Starting region-sliced rollout v2.4.0 -> US=15%, EU=0%, APAC=0 (canary). Change window 2024-08-12 01:00-05:00 UTC. Auto-holdpoints at 15% increments.
Priya: Kicking off US canary. Please watch per-route token time and 5xx. I'll post quick heatmap.
Ben: US warm pool looks good. p50=95ms, p95=190ms. Warm nodes: 42/50. CPU avg 26%. No 5xx.
Ilya: EU reserved capacity = 30 GPUs, alloc=78%. If EU ramp >10% during peak traffic we risk filling to 90% within ~18m.
SRE Oncall: Thermal margin 14%. Eviction threshold set at warmpool <70%. Will flag at 75% proactively.
Marta: For EU overflow plan: pin EU to v2.3.9, reduce EU slice to 5% and enable backpressure. That was the last agreed sequence.
Priya: Confirmed sequence: pin -> throttle -> rollback if metrics don't recover in 8m.
Deploy Bot: US health: 15% -> healthy. checks=ok(60/60), errs=0, avgGPU=31%. No alarms.
Infra-Priv Bot: APAC artifact egress blocked: infra-priv needing explicit allowlist for release buckets. Ticket #INF-483 opened.
Ilya: APAC has no reserved warmpool for this release. We'll need +8 GPUs to start a baseline canary. Cost approved by infra, but require infra-priv signoff.
Ben: I can spin transient +8 GPUs for up to 45m if infra-priv grants egress. Ping me in thread when allowed.
SRE Oncall: +1 for transient burst. I'll monitor host pressure and OOM counts. If we see >=2 OOMs in 5m we'll auto-triage.
Marta: Rollback triggers we are using this run: (a) p95 token latency >2x baseline for >10m, (b) route error rate >0.8% sustained 6m, (c) GPU OOMs >=2 in 5m, (d) warm node loss >=10% in 3m.
Priya: Adding business impact note: if payment route errors >0.5% we escalate immediately and rollback.
Ilya: Preparing EU pre-pin: snapshot model, enable verbose audit logs, hold config snapshot. Notifying security and SRE.
Deploy Bot: EU ramp command queued -> target 5% after US holdpoint.
SRE Oncall: EU live @5% (2m): p50=120ms, p95=245ms, errs=0. No OOMs. Warmpool usage +1%.
Infra-Priv Bot: INF-483: egress allowlist updated for bucket releases/v2.4.0. APAC release artifact access granted to infra account.
Ben: Spinning +8 GPUs for APAC now. Expected ready in ~4m.
Marta: If EU spikes and warmpool >85% we will pin EU to v2.3.9 and set slice to 0% as emergency fallback.
Priya: Runbook (quick):
```
redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.3.9
redwoodctl set-slice --region eu --percent 0
redwoodctl rollback --release v2.4.0 --reason "region capacity or latency"
```
Ilya: Noted. Also check KV-cache sticky flag for EU slice; turning it on might reduce cold-token cost and smooth p95.
Deploy Bot: APAC canary started: target 5% -> active. health=ok(10/10), errs=0, avgCPU=37%.
SRE Oncall: APAC thermal stable. Monitoring network egress rates.
Marta: Hold all ramps for 12m and reconvene for post-hold readout. If all three regions stable we move to 30% next wave.
Priya: I'll post readout to #release-updates in 12m. Everyone please call out any anomalies in this thread first.
Ben: 12m readout scheduled. Standing by. :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: Holdpoint reached. US/EU/APAC at 15/5/5 respectively (APAC transient). Next automatic ramp at +15% after manual ack.
SRE Oncall: Keeping thermal hooks open. Will escalate pager if eviction or OOM thresholds breached.
Priya: thanks team — will update after holdpoint.
